name: openpencil
description: Create, inspect, preview, and save editable OpenPencil designs with Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Design editable UI on your local OpenPencil canvas
interface.longDescription: Open an editable Rust canvas for your conversation. The matching native editor, WASM and CanvasKit runtime downloads automatically on first use and is verified before launch. Interactive edits and Codex tools share one document, with selection prompts, guarded saves and recovery drafts. Requires Node.js 22+ and a local executor.
defaultPrompt: Open an interactive OpenPencil canvas for this conversation.
Create a single-page dashboard in OpenPencil.
Inspect and refine the selected OpenPencil frame.
